ns2:section.sectionText: This course will not satisfy the 400-level Finance major requirements. This Fintech Practicum will provide a foundational understanding of Fintech, explore potential Fintech careers, and provide hands-on experience learning about real world Fintech problems and deliverables in the corporate environment. The program will focus on case studies and experiential learning opportunities, team building activities, project management, and mentorship. Deliverables will include research papers and project summaries. Strong quantitative skills and initiative is required. Please contact the instructor at hartja@illinois.edu for permission to enroll in this course.
